title: A Serviced Vehicle and the Rate a Restoration Charge Is Taken At
content:
A vehicle kept under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan lowers the charge for restoring cover on its Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment, and a workshop visit inside the last six months lowers it further.

- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and a workshop visit stands on it in the six months before, the charge is taken at the marketplace's serviced-vehicle rate of 92 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and no workshop visit stands in that period, it is taken at the marketplace's unserviced-plan rate of 97 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, no rate is applied on that account.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on a charge of 200 before this step)

| Care plan on the vehicle | Workshop visit in the six months before | Charge becomes |
|---|---|---|
| Active | one or more | 184.00 |
| Active | none | 194.00 |
| Not active, or none held | — | 200.00 |

One visit in the period is enough to reach the first reading; the visits are not counted beyond the first.

### Source of the readings

The standing of the care plan and the workshop visits on the vehicle are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle, counting visits within the six months before.
